detailed_description: The Meta Tag Generator builds a simple block of HTML meta tags from browser form fields. You can enter a page title, description, keywords, author, Open Graph image URL, page URL, Twitter card type, Twitter site handle, robots option, and viewport value, then copy the generated markup. The output includes charset, viewport, title, description, keywords, author, robots, basic Open Graph tags with `og:type` fixed to `website`, and basic Twitter Card tags. Values are escaped before being inserted into attributes. The tool does not validate against W3C rules, check duplicate tags, preview social cards, generate schema.org markup, support dynamic Open Graph types, process existing pages, or provide batch CSV import/export.
usage_steps: Enter the page title, description, and any optional keywords or author.
Add an Open Graph image URL and page URL if needed.
Choose a Twitter card type and enter a Twitter site handle when useful.
Choose the robots option and edit the viewport value if needed.
Copy the generated meta tag markup from the output panel.
usage_examples: Generate starter title and description tags for a small static page.
Create basic Open Graph and Twitter Card tags from one page title and image URL.
Copy a viewport and robots meta tag block for a prototype HTML document.
Draft simple metadata markup before manually reviewing it in your project.
